newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Queensland directors join Bank of Qld.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Queensland directors join Bank of Qld.

text.p: Bank of Queensland Ltd shareholders voted on Thursday for the appointment of three new directors, nominated by the Queensland state government, to represent its 44 percent stake in the regional bank.
The three new directors, Don Harvey, Neil Summerson and Daryl McDonough were appointed after being introduced at the bank's annual meeting by chairman Neil Roberts.
They replace former Suncorp chairman, Graham Tucker and fellow directors Ted Ranson and Bernard Rowley who have resigned.

Tucker, Ranson and another Suncorp director, John Wruck, resigned from Suncorp in September after declaring publicly they were unable to form an opinion on whether a merger of their company with Metway Bank Ltd MWB AX and Queensland Industry Development Corp (QIDC) was in Suncorp's interest.
The Queensland state government subsequently submitted resolutions to the Bank of Queensland's annual meeting that they be removed and new government nominees appointed.
Harvey, deputy chairman of QCT Resources and a former director of Sunshine Broadcasting said his appointment as a Bank of Queensland director was "not of his doing."
"I stand as an independent. I am not a member of any pilitical party and the government probably had not heard of me until recently," Harvey told shareholders.
"I have not been given any instructions and the government does not wish us to carry out any instructions," Harvey said.
